pokedexEntries.rb: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

pokedexEntries.ye: Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.

pokedexEntries.go: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.

pokedexEntries.si: A sweet sap leaks from its tail’s tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.

pokedexEntries.cr: It is always so absent-minded that it won’t react, even if its flavorful tail is bitten.

pokedexEntries.rs: SLOWPOKE uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in water at the side of a river. However, this POKéMON often forgets what it’s doing and often spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.

pokedexEntries.fr: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

pokedexEntries.oras: Slowpoke uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in water at the side of a river. However, this Pokémon often forgets what it’s doing and often spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.

pokedexEntries.su: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn’t really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn’t particularly bothered.

pokedexEntries.mo: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

pokedexEntries.us: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.

pokedexEntries.um: Although their tails, which fall off naturally, can easily be found lying around, they’re a precious ingredient for cooking.

pokedexEntries.sw: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won’t feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won’t notice when its tail grows back, either.

pokedexEntries.sh: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.
